name: @ezpug/gamemode-kit
description: The widget toolchain of EZPug Iron (decision 17): a Vite library preset that builds a gamemode's widget/ into one custom-element bundle, the runtime a widget is written on (the link to the orchestrator's widget socket, the host handshake, the design tokens with fallbacks, a tiny t()), and a dev harness that mounts the widget against the fake orchestrator the way the platform does.
